title: Learning to Prompt: Improving Student Engagement with Adaptive LLM-based High-School Tutoring
abstract: arXiv:2606.20138v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LLMs can personalize education, although current static-prompt tutoring systems struggle to adapt to diverse academic disciplines. We develop and test a system with subject-aware prompting, based on 14 pedagogical features (e.g., tutor scaffolding, student understanding) extracted from raw transcripts. We first train a prompt routing model in a simulation environment, and then deploy it for online adaptation with actual high-school students. The simulation benchmark shows the router outperforming two static baselines ($0.694$ vs. $0.647$ and $0.64$, $p<0.001$). A/B testing ($N=656$ conversations from 359 students) shows sim-to-real transfer where the model switches from analytical to scaffolding learning strategies. Our adaptive prompt selection mechanism improves instructional efficiency, maintains pedagogical quality and reduces interactions by around 3 turns ($p=0.007$). translated_title: 学习提示：通过自适应大语言模型高中辅导提升学生参与度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.20138v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：大语言模型能够个性化教育，尽管当前的静态提示辅导系统难以适应不同的学科领域。我们开发并测试了一个具有学科感知提示的系统，该系统基于从原始对话记录中提取的14个教学特征（例如，辅导脚手架、学生理解程度）。我们首先在模拟环境中训练一个提示路由模型，然后将其部署到实际高中学生的在线自适应场景中。模拟基准测试显示，该路由器的表现优于两个静态基线（$0.694$对比$0.647$和$0.64$，$p<0.001$）。A/B测试（来自359名学生的656次对话）显示了从模拟到实际的迁移，其中模型从分析性学习策略切换到脚手架学习策略。我们的自适应提示选择机制提高了教学效率，保持了教学质量，并减少了约3轮交互（$p=0.007$）。而贪婪路由器在练习方面达到了可比的性能。
tldr: 本研究提出一种基于14个教学特征的自适应提示路由模型，在高中辅导中显著提升教学效率并减少交互轮数，实现了从模拟到实际的有效迁移。
en_tdlr: This study proposes an adaptive prompt routing model based on 14 pedagogical features, which significantly improves instructional efficiency and reduces interaction turns in high-school tutoring, demonstrating effective sim-to-real transfer.
